scope: Reader semantics for CUSVAR198 and DYNARY266 only. Does not establish custom store allocation, selectors, model mutations or complete import equivalence.

custom_variable_header.line: one fgets1024, no blank skipping; comma replaced with space before scan
custom_variable_header.initialization: All four int32 destinations and binary64 default zeroed before fgets; partial conversions retain assignments and zero tails.
custom_variable_header.status: 1 only fgetsEOF or sscanf result-1; conversion0 and partial positive results return0.
custom_variable_header.conversion_count: Exposed as reconstruction metadata; native helper does not return this separately.
custom_variable_header.grammar: Integer conversions base0; real conversion uses prior recovered scanf decimal grammar, not DYNARY atof grammar.

dynamic_array_header.format: One fgets1024 then strtok delimiters space/comma/LF/TAB/CR. VT and FF are not delimiters. Maximum10 tokens; the entire bounded line was already consumed, so unused token text does not remain in the stream.
dynamic_array_header.token_count: On a read line, count starts1 even if first strtok returnsNULL. Missing/index-out-of-range accessor strings begin withNUL by retained byte reads. Empty line is represented as tokens=[emptystring],token_count1. EOF returnsstatus1 before native count/global tokens reset; reconstructed count0 onEOF is metadata only and must not be interpreted as native mutation.
dynamic_array_header.global_state: Native uses global1024byte line and128pointer array, clearing firstmin(limit,128) pointers. Selected limit10/calleraccess0..6 are modeled as an owned per-call snapshot; arbitrarylimits,tokenpointeridentity,reentrancy not reproduced.
dynamic_array_header.integer_tokens: First5 tokens are signed32 base10 strtol prefix conversions; missing/non-numeric token yields0; hexadecimal-looking0x10 yields0, leading010 yields10. Overflow/underflow explicitlyunsupported rather than modeling native saturation/errno.
dynamic_array_header.optional_fields: integers[5]=converted token5 when token_count>=6, otherwiseintegers[3]. default_value=converted token6 only when token_count>6, otherwise+0.
dynamic_array_header.atof_grammar: Wrapper skips C-locale whitespace, invokes _fltin2 and returnsdval ignoring flags. Parser accepts sign, decimaldigits/decimalpoint, E/e orD/d exponent; malformed exponent reverts to significand, invalid initial token returns+0; implicit_E=0 excludes sign-only exponent shorthand. No modern hexadecimal/INF/NAN lexical branch.
dynamic_array_header.atof_implementation: NormalizeD/d toE/e in a private token copy and use recovered decimal-prefix lexer; convert bounded accepted decimal through C-locale strtod. Captured numeric rounding for this new helper remains pending; native computes through12byte intermediate and _ld12tod, so universal bit-rounding equivalence is not claimed.

connectivity3.semantics: label+threeint32, alloutputs zero beforeonefgets1024;comma→space;no blankskip;status1 onlyfgetsEOF/sscanf-1. Caller chooses sequential or indexed storage; reader does not infer placement.

limitations: Scientific field meanings and payloadstore behavior belong to parent recovery, not this reader contract.
Integer overflow, floatingrange underflow/overflow, locale changes, embeddedNUL and allocationfailure remain unsupported.
Legacy12byte floating intermediate rounding is not fully reconstructed; finite selected test corpus must be checked against original.
Native token global storage/lifetime is represented by per-call owned values within DYNARYlimit10 profile.
No original process launched, no candidateoutputs used to infer nativeexpectedvalues; replacement-only unit cases follow retained static contracts.
